agent_explanation: Controller computes proportional force kp*m*(v_desired - v_actual) plus seeded noise but never clamps magnitude to fmax. At step 0 velocity error is ~10 m/s (desired ~(-5.9,-10.2) toward waypoint vs actual (0,-18)), so kp~25.8 demands ~200+ N, exceeding fmax 160.365 at step 1 (208.475 N). Lowering kp removes the violation, confirming missing saturation/clamp.
